channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Rialto redevelopment ordered to implement park and ride for roof top events
item.description: The Environment and Planning Review Tribunal has confirmed the Planning Authority’s approval for the redevelopment of Bormla’s historic Rialto Theatre, but ordered an amendment to the permit

item.title: Israel and US launch strikes on Iran as Trump declares war
item.description: In an eight-minute video on his social media platform, US President Donald Trump officially declared war on Iran, promising to destroy the country's military capabilities

item.title: Maltese nationals in United Arab Emirates urged to be cautious in the wake of missile attacks
item.description: The Maltese embassy in the UAE warns of a 'significantly heightened risk of regional tension'

item.title: Bernard Grech will seek reelection
item.description: The former PN leader admitted that he was leading the party in Roberta Metsola's shadow during his first interview since stepping down last June

item.title: Suspended police sergeant back in the dock for aiding home robbery
item.description: Glen Carabott was charged with possession of an illegal weapon, committing offences while acting as a public official, and breaching two separate sets of bail conditions

item.title: Court of appeal quashes eight-year sentence human trafficking judgement
item.description: Court highlighted the legal threshold for the offence of human trafficking was not met, upholding the arguments of the defence regarding inconsistencies in the victim’s testimon

item.title: Alex Borg proposes anti-deadlock mechanism for chief justice appointment
item.description: Opposition Leader Alex Borg accuses Prime Minister Robert Abela of 'disrupting the process of appointing a chief justice for partisan aims'

item.title: Momentum seeks political alliance prior to general election
item.description: Momentum said it is open to engaging with parties willing to rally around a shared set of principles based on transparency, meritocracy and effective governance

item.title: Doctor tells court 94-year-old suspect is not fit to stand trial over Xewkija shooting
item.description: A medical report has raised doubts over whether a 94-year-old Gozitan man accused of attempting to murder his neighbour can stand trial by jury, as proceedings continue over a 2019 shooting incident in Xewkija

item.title: Labour readies its election war room
item.description: Strategy meetings have been taking place at Labour HQ, as individuals involved in past election campaigns from the Joseph Muscat era have been seen regularly at party HQ over the past few days
